scope: Installed Cloakfox, headful, disposable profiles; 3 page loads per library/case. Same-site return uses a fresh tab, not bfcache or a retained document. Exact library bundle checksums and clean CreepJS checkout enforced.
limits: FingerprintJS 5.3 intentionally skips default canvas images on modern Gecko including native control; exported getUnstableCanvasFingerprint(false) tests real images without modifying library source.
CreepJS retains font/rectangle/canvas noise and GPU suspicion flags. Chrome identity retains a SpiderMonkey/V8 engine mismatch. Passing stability/isolation checks does not mean undetectable.
CreepJS canvas aggregate hashes can vary because randomized modification diagnostics vary; all five actual canvas image fields are checked independently for stability.
No same-tab bfcache, browser restart, real camera or microphone permission tests are added by this library probe; earlier owning-frame and media tests remain separate.
